name: tip-me-a-coffee
description: A self-hosted, embeddable "Tip me a coffee" button. Humans and AI agents tip over x402, settled by Atum.

ATUM_ENV.description: `stub` runs a demo that moves no funds. `testnet` or `mainnet` settle real tips through Atum.

DEST_ADDRESS.description: The address that receives your tips on the destination chain. Required unless `ATUM_ENV` is `stub`.

DEST_ASSET.description: The token you receive, as a CAIP-19 id from [Atum's supported assets](https://docs.atum.xyz/get-started/reference/supported-assets). Required on `mainnet`.

SOURCE_ASSETS.description: Comma-separated CAIP-19 ids of the tokens payers may pay with. Leave empty for the default.

TIP_AMOUNTS.description: The tip menu, in units of the token you receive, for example `1,3,5`.

AUTHOR_NAME.description: Your name, shown on the tip page.

MARKUP_BPS.description: How far the payer's spend cap may exceed the tip, in basis points. At most `500`.
